items.title: Epidemiological update – 11 August 2026: Imported case of Andes hantavirus in the EU/EEA
items.title_en: Epidemiological update – 11 August 2026: Imported case of Andes hantavirus in the EU/EEA
items.body: On 6 August 2026, French public health authorities reported an imported case of Andes hantavirus infection in a traveller from Argentina.
items.body_en: On 6 August 2026, French public health authorities reported an imported case of Andes hantavirus infection in a traveller from Argentina.
